_doc: coverage.mjs overrides. kinds: item id -> {kind, why} (id = handler name, page:<view>, dialog:<element id>); kind is view | dialog | action | print | none (none = not counted, say why). patterns: [{re, type?, kind, why}] applied when no exact entry. replays: item id -> the check-3 replay that covers the rule behind it. uncovered: item id -> the written reason it is not covered yet (the ready bar needs one for every uncovered item).

flBackupData.why: legacy-only: downloads the browser's whole-state blob (localStorage backup); the backend replaces it

flImportData.why: legacy-only: loads a whole-state blob into the browser; the importers replace it

resetAllData.why: legacy-only: wipes the browser's local state

exportHTML.why: legacy-only: saves the page as an offline HTML copy

laRetrySaveNow.why: legacy-only: retries the whole-state /api/v1/_batch save (not reimplemented, CLAUDE.md)

poSaveRetry.why: legacy-only: retries a failed whole-state save of the pier office

flProjMigrate.why: one-off client-side data migration of fleet projects (the importer did it)

agAlertSyncRate.why: writes the agent's rate type from an alert

patterns.why: dev tool: the developers' change log panel
dev tool: bug-capture panel (screenshots for the developers)
